items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Well, I adopted the style of Brian Hines.

ctx.x: and you fall in line. Yeah. Why did they call you father,

father Al? Well, I adopted the style of Brian Hines. Well, when we get through this I'll play you a number on guitar or something like that and show you. So he's father Hines and you're father Al? Father Al. Wow. Yeah, you see, just the way he played, I had a theme song similar to his theme song. His theme song was, uh, uh, with Deforest's Oil Hines and this other. My theme song was, uh, uh, Crazy Moments and, uh, well we just had one neighbor, it was an African effect, the one we would sign off with and one we…
Well back to Chinatown while you were talking about it, were there many joints in the neighborhood there?
